messages.subject: Mining & Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear PARTNER Executive Team,

Your specialist executive-search work across mining, metals, critical minerals, energy, power and infrastructure makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where resources or energy strategy depends on regulatory discipline, stakeholder trust, responsible development and coordinated execution. I am internationally mobile for suitable mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
